name: llm-away-inline
description: Inline code suggestions from a loaded LLM-AWAY model session.

llmAwayInline.repositoryPath.description: Local LLM-AWAY repository root (not its local/ subfolder).

llmAwayInline.completionMode.description: Prompt style: auto picks fill-in-the-middle (FIM) for Qwen Coder models, chat otherwise. fim/chat force a style.

llmAwayInline.debounceMs.description: Typing pause before requesting a suggestion.

llmAwayInline.maxTokens.description: Maximum generated tokens, including any model reasoning.

llmAwayInline.timeoutMs.description: Display deadline for a suggestion. A slow inference retains its slot until the gateway finishes it.

llmAwayInline.fileContextRefreshSeconds.description: Refresh the changed active-file snapshot after this interval. Saves and file switches refresh immediately. No background model calls.

llmAwayInline.fileContextMaxChars.description: Full-file snapshot character limit (0 disables full-file context). The model context budget may impose a smaller limit; oversized files use cursor excerpts.

llmAwayInline.preferEfficientCode.description: Prefer efficient algorithms and existing library operations (including NumPy for numeric arrays), while considering readability and memory. This is model guidance, not a performance guarantee.
